paper_title: Constraints on axions from patchy screening of the cosmic microwave background
suggested_experiment_name: unWISE Blue × Planck CMB patchy screening
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper presents a NEW measured exclusion limit on the axion-photon coupling g_agamma from cross-correlation of CMB patchy screening maps (constructed from Planck data using NILC foreground cleaning) with the unWISE Blue galaxy survey. The constraint is g_agamma ≲ 2×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for axion masses 10^-13 eV ≲ m_a ≲ 10^-12 eV. This is a mass-dependent bound spanning a narrow range; the limit is approximately constant across the stated mass range. Encoded as a horizontal line at the two mass boundaries. The measurement is based on a null detection (PTE=0.61, χ²=9.2 for 11 dof) of the cross-power spectrum C^{g T̃^a}_ℓ between axion-induced CMB screening and galaxy overdensity. This is a cosmological/astrophysical bound (not a haloscope DM density search), so dm_density_assumed is null.
